title: Colts reportedly offered FA QB Daniel Jones ‘Sam Darnold money,’ but his camp had rather lofty counter offer

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Colts reportedly offered FA QB Daniel Jones ‘Sam Darnold money,’ but his camp had rather lofty counter offer
sources.description: After contract negotiations remained initially ‘far apart,’ it’s easy to see why the Colts ultimately used the transition tag on free agent QB Daniel Jones.
